carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin surface contains approximately 8 distinct high-luminance blobs, primarily located in the central and posterior regions of the fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible notch is present on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin. A small, dark, circular indentation is visible on the ventral flank, anterior to the pelvic fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin, partially visible in the lower right, exhibits a significantly higher density of smaller, irregularly shaped high-luminance spots compared to the primary flank pattern.
